deviations: The formation candidates apply only to captains whose plate is 'vertical' layout (all captains today), as the packet's step 4 sits in the vertical branch; `formed` is only set when actingNow.

The new e2e describe uses beforeEach/afterEach (a fresh app per pod), not one app: Pulsar's renderer crashed ('Target crashed' in the beat scan) when it ran after Quasar in the same window, as the packet warned. Cost: ~2 min for the pair.

The file-level beforeAll of solar-dense.spec.ts still launches the Meridian app for the new describe's tests too (unused there); Playwright hooks at file level apply to every describe. Harmless, a little slower.
The (c) side check counts all acting plates in a sample by that sample's ship extents; the 90% threshold was kept as written.
limitations: Trade-off (packet step 6): a member with no place clear of the other members' ships now stays a picture (label.blocked) instead of covering a ship; rare.
